selection_instruction: In the Codex CLI composer run /model, select the exact Daybreak Blue model ID and an explicitly recorded effort, then inspect /status and effective run metadata before sending the scoped review.
scope: Defensive security review and hardening assistance for every declared module and integrated release; model output is evidence to verify, not acceptance authority. Planning analysis is read-only by default. Reproduction uses explicitly owned disposable targets under actual action authorization; engine repairs, tests, dependencies and release work require Luke’s actual coding instruction and applicable scope.

modules.focus: Untrusted schema/frame bounds, compatibility, identity preservation and parser fuzz controls.
modules.fault_and_benign: Reject oversized/malformed or incompatible payload before allocation/dispatch; accept the bounded compatible counterpart.

modules.focus: Unauthorized state transitions, forged/stale acceptance, replay, cancellation/acceptance races and effect custody.
modules.fault_and_benign: Late result, cancellation/acceptance race and exhausted budget never create duplicate effects or false acceptance; valid current result can advance.

modules.focus: Transaction integrity, migration immutability, concurrent writers, corruption and restored outstanding obligations.
modules.fault_and_benign: Crash between coupled writes yields all-or-nothing state; checksum mismatch and unsupported schema refuse before mutation; valid history migrates.

modules.focus: Spoofed agent/model/service identity, stale health, capability escalation and provenance.
modules.fault_and_benign: Spoofed identity, conflicting update, disabled record and stale health exclude dispatch; compatible fresh registration remains eligible.

modules.focus: Eligibility/privacy bypass, silent model substitution, stale evaluations and constrained fallback.
modules.fault_and_benign: Unknown/unsupported capability, stale evaluation or forbidden data location cannot be selected; valid constrained fallback does not relax grants.

modules.focus: Concurrent overcommit, omitted checker/context usage and ambiguous-effect liabilities.
modules.fault_and_benign: Concurrent oversubscription, duplicate usage, failed worker and uncertain cancellation keep liabilities visible; valid settled work releases safely.

modules.focus: Process/workspace custody, hostile output, real model identity, cancellation and residual writable children.
modules.fault_and_benign: Wrong model, partial/oversized frame, hostile output, timeout or surviving writable child fails or remains pending; valid result retains provenance.

modules.focus: Forged evidence, compromised fixtures, invalid denominator and independent verifier/collector custody.
modules.fault_and_benign: Mutate fixture identity, case inventory, profile, producer status or raw log; reject each without accepting an aggregate count.

modules.focus: PID reuse, stale epochs, duplicate execution, incomplete cleanup and lost-response readback.
modules.fault_and_benign: PID reuse, restored epoch, stale result and partial cleanup do not attach to the wrong work; a live owned child is recognized.

modules.focus: Cross-thread write collisions, context/grant contamination, missing/contradictory child evidence and false parent joins.
modules.fault_and_benign: Overlapping writes, stale brief, missing child or contradictory evidence prevents parent success; disjoint valid work can converge.

modules.focus: Prompt injection, unsafe source paths, bounded expansion, data minimization and provenance.
modules.fault_and_benign: Injection text, unsafe path, recursive expansion and stale/missing dependency stay denied or visible as gaps; valid bounded references remain usable.

modules.focus: Visibility leakage, outbox-before-commit, replay/epoch errors and slow subscriber resource abuse.
modules.fault_and_benign: Pre-commit delivery, wrong visibility, expired/restored cursor and slow consumer cannot corrupt task state; valid resync works.

modules.focus: Unauthorized lifecycle effects, wrong owner/unit, useful-health spoofing and uncertain replay.
modules.fault_and_benign: Unauthorized action, wrong unit, useless-but-listening service and lost reply never imply healthy completion; valid useful probe succeeds.

modules.focus: Client/pane authority confusion, stale UI truth, reconnect/cancel and duplicate submission.
modules.fault_and_benign: Duplicate submission, stale event, display failure and cancellation do not invent acceptance; valid current state remains visible.

modules.focus: Rust/Julia framing, memory/device bounds, immutable dataset identity, units and untrusted artifacts.
modules.fault_and_benign: Wrong shape/units, nonfinite/oversized output, stale dataset, crash/cancel or incompatible device rejects the candidate; valid report remains reviewable.

modules.focus: Numerical oracle validity, data leakage, nonfinite/shape/unit input, out-of-domain behavior and reproducibility.
modules.fault_and_benign: Wrong units/shape, data leakage, invalid oracle and out-of-domain operator request fail or use an explicit baseline fallback; in-domain known cases pass.

modules.focus: Local socket permissions/peer custody, startup races, config validation, dependency composition and shutdown.
modules.fault_and_benign: Bad config, startup race, unavailable dependency, insecure socket and broken-pipe status refuse truthfully; valid useful health is observable.

modules.focus: Hidden capability leakage, schema/version drift, ungranted effect and CLI/tool/UDS parity.
modules.fault_and_benign: Hidden action, unknown version, malformed argument and ungranted effect refuse before dispatch; visible compatible action retains identical semantics.

modules.focus: Literal argv, shell metacharacters, pipeline producer status, environment and cancellation.
modules.fault_and_benign: Command-like input remains data, missing executable/failed pipeline/cancel returns failure, and a valid literal argument round-trips.

modules.focus: Host/tool version, stale callbacks, cross-call identity, reload and permission parity.
modules.fault_and_benign: Stale callback, mismatched host/call version, parallel call contamination and cancel race cannot return another call’s success; current valid calls work.

modules.focus: Instruction-as-grant confusion, unsafe references, stale dependencies and bounded source scope.
modules.fault_and_benign: Conflicting instructions, retired/stale references, path escape and incompatible action versions refuse or surface gaps; valid pinned skill remains usable.

modules.focus: Injected steps, cycles, retries after uncertain effects, source/wrapper drift and independent final verification.
modules.fault_and_benign: Cycles, unknown steps, missing child, budget exhaustion and failed final verifier prevent success; valid settled steps are not repeated.

stages.name: Threat model before implementation
stages.result: Bound module/data/trust/effect surfaces, threats and intended-fault/benign controls.

stages.name: Review the actual candidate
stages.result: Inspect exact code/interface/dependency/config/test subject; reproduce candidate findings in admitted disposable scope.

stages.name: Repair and reverify
stages.result: Authorized implementation owner repairs; independent deterministic tests and reviewer recheck bind the changed integrated subject.

stages.name: Integrated release and migration review
stages.result: Close applicable T17/T18/T25-T27 obligations, installation/recovery and migration immutability findings; separate admission remains required.

receipt_fields: requested model alias and effective model/revision when exposed; unknown stays unknown
Codex version, session/worker identity, reasoning effort, selection observation and review_model override disposition
bounded review scope, allowed effects/resources and threat-model revision
reproducible finding, location, impact, intended fault and benign control
repair identity, independent raw results and re-verification disposition
remaining uncertainty/material findings, reviewer identity and acceptance authority separation

Structured identity observation: requested_model, selection_surface, selection_observed, effective_model, effective_revision if exposed, effort, review_model_override, observation_source, identity_verdict. A launch-time override or delegated agent invocation is not interactive /model evidence. Unknown fields remain null, never inferred.

Repair binding: pre-fix finding subject digest, post-fix candidate digest, exact repair diff/range, affected dependency/config/fixture/harness identities, finding-to-test mapping and regression-selection rationale. Rerun affected qualifications and integrated regressions; material subject/profile changes invalidate earlier applicability.

Security profile revision/hash plus completion/interface standard hashes; retain independent review and exact evidence for an intentional profile revision. The editable semantic baseline is a drift tripwire, not authenticated admission.

selection_observation.identity_verdict: requested only; interactive picker not evidenced
